title: Bending Stainless Exhaust Tubing: Mandrels, Springback & Test Bends
excerpt: Bending stainless exhaust tubing without wrinkles: when you need a mandrel, how to measure springback with a test bend, and how to back purge welds.

notes: REWRITE of draft #39, written fresh; keep slug. All unsourced numbers from the old draft (tonnage, 60-80% springback, 93°/94°, ram speed %, cooling cycles, 200°F) were dropped; springback is taught via the test-bend method. Direct page fetches were blocked in this environment, so Rogue Fab, Burns, Miller, Harris and Ticon facts came from WebSearch result summaries; formula/ovality/Baileigh/Pro-Tools/Stainless Headers facts came from the fact-check notes (also search-summary based). Please spot-check: (1) Rogue Fab exhaust page: mandrel for 304 exhaust when wall ratio > 20 or 'D/R' < 3.0 (interpreted as D of bend). (2) Rogue Fab: 316 springs back slightly more than 304; bronze is the standard mandrel material; thin-wall roller advertised 10.0% -> 6.4% deformation with regular dies (fact-check notes say about 5-7% vs about 10%, consistent). (3) Fabricator ovality tolerance 1.5-8% depending on end use is from the fact-check notes, which cite The Fabricator without a single exact URL. (4) 'Many fabricators keep separate brushes/discs for stainless' is stated as common practice without a specific source; editor may cut it. (5) Harris Type B: mixed with alcohol, brushed on the back of the joint, for stainless except 309/310 (listing summary); 'chore to clean off' is from customer reviews and phrased as user reports. (6) Ticon kit contents (2 each 2.5/3/3.5/4 in, 8 mesh diffusers, 4 Ti inlet tubes) and the brand's 'weld seam 1 in away' heat claim are from the listing summary. (7) The 1.5D bend B079P687YJ: specs from the listing title only; seller/brand not confirmed in search results. Web search budget ran out during research, so nothing further could be verified. Formula, ovality, Baileigh RDB-175 and Pro-Tools facts were taken from /home/user/website/docs/research/competitors-keywords-factcheck.md Part 3.
